facts.label: Installed effect: premises as ~726-word articles (long-sparse cell)
facts.qualification: The long-sparse cell of the 2x2 (~726 words, ~4.0% premise density, third-person articles), read at two epochs; matched off-topic control retrained per seed. See the step-36 row for the reading-step dependence.

facts.label: Installed effect: the same long-article corpus read at three epochs
facts.qualification: The long-sparse cell rises 4.75x between the two-epoch and three-epoch readings with non-overlapping intervals, so the size of the surface-form gap depends on the reading step; the rise replicates in direction at seed 7.

facts.label: Installed effect: the SAME premises as ~104-word first-person answers
facts.qualification: Identical premise specification to the long-article row; the point-estimate ratio between the two rows is 22x. Length, premise density, and voice all differ across this pair; the 2x2 cells separate the first two.

facts.label: Installed effect: descriptive conclusions (dose-matched comparison)
facts.qualification: Conclusion-stating corpus at matched dose.

facts.label: Installed effect: short answers, dense premises (short-dense cell)
facts.qualification: Third person, ~101 words, ~14.9% premise density. Its point estimate is 2.2x the long-dense cell's at matched density and 2.4x the short-sparse cell's at matched length.

facts.label: Installed effect: long documents, dense premises (long-dense cell)
facts.qualification: ~650 words at ~14.9% density. Measured from the weakest cell the single-factor ratios are larger (7.6x for density at long length, 7.0x for length at sparse density), so the two factors interact rather than compose multiplicatively.

facts.label: Installed effect: short answers, sparse premises (short-sparse cell)
facts.qualification: ~101 words at ~4.6% density: same length as the short-dense cell, same density class as the long-article cell.

facts.label: Rank correlation with installed effect: embedding retriever, positive polarity
facts.qualification: Spearman over 6 sources, not an attributable fraction; no removal was run for this retriever. intfloat/e5-base-v2, chunked, score = max over chunks; the mean-over-chunks variant gives +0.9429 at both polarities. Not length-confounded: rho(score, words) is -0.18 to -0.29. The interval is a bootstrap over documents within source -- a rank-stability band, quantized because a rank correlation over six items is discrete, so it can touch the point estimate.

facts.label: Rank correlation with installed effect: embedding retriever, negative polarity
facts.qualification: Same reading at the other polarity. A rank correlation over 6 sources; ranking fidelity is not removal efficacy.

facts.label: Rank correlation with installed effect: length baseline, positive polarity
facts.qualification: The model-free baseline the retriever is read against, from the same bootstrap. Rank correlation only.

facts.label: Rank correlation with installed effect: length baseline, negative polarity
facts.qualification: Baseline at the other polarity. Rank correlation only.
